svg.text: CARRIED FROM THE MOTHER CODEX v3.48.0 · BARRIER-MASTER-01 · ABSOLUTE-PNP-BARRIERS-01 · CITED AT THEIR OWN GRADES
Every wall binds on its own quantifier. A total wall on the bit's routes is the bit's negation (total_wall_iff_negation), so the walls stand on their quantifiers and the bit is
theorem on no axiom at all
